Tests for {@link SimpleBloomFilter}.

This class inherits the full suite of standard Bloom filter tests from {@link AbstractBloomFilterTest} and adds tests for behaviours that are specific to {@code SimpleBloomFilter}'s internal bit-map representation, in particular how the filter handles a {@link BitMapExtractor} that yields fewer bit-map words than the filter's {@link Shape} requires.

Verifies that merging a {@link BitMapExtractor} that produces fewer bit-map words than the shape expects is handled gracefully.

The test shape ({@code Shape.fromKM(17, 72)}) requires two 64-bit words to hold 72 bits, but the extractor below supplies only one word whose value is {@code 2L} (binary {@code ...0010}), meaning exactly bit 1 is set. After the merge the filter should still report success and its cardinality should reflect only that single set bit.
Supply one 64-bit word (bit 1 set = value 2) instead of the two words that the 72-bit shape would normally require.
